about.disclaimer: Academic prototype. This application provides no diagnostic value and does not replace the judgment of a radiologist or physician under any circumstances.
about.overview_text: This project classifies chest X-rays into four categories (COVID-19, lung opacity, viral pneumonia, normal) using a convolutional neural network, with Grad-CAM attention maps for explainability and automatic structured report generation.
limitations: The model classifies the whole image; it does not reliably localize any abnormality (Grad-CAM shows an attention area, not a clinical localization).
Lower recall on the COVID-19 class (~77%) — see the README for the per-class breakdown.
Imbalanced dataset, not clinically validated by a radiologist.
about.roadmap_done: ✅ Documented architecture · ✅ Input validation · ✅ AI report (PDF/JSON) · ✅ Comparative Grad-CAM · ✅ Docker · ✅ CI/CD · ✅ Multi-page navigation · ✅ Persistence (History, Dashboard) · ✅ Full internationalization (en/fr/ar) · ✅ Editable settings
about.roadmap_pending: 🚧 AI Assistant (RAG + Ollama) — not tested end-to-end with a real Ollama server
about.footer_built_with: Built with TensorFlow, Streamlit, Plotly and ReportLab.

home.how_it_works_text: This prototype classifies chest X-rays into four categories using a convolutional neural network trained on a public chest X-ray dataset. For each image, the model produces a per-class probability and a Grad-CAM map localizing the regions that drove its prediction.
home.step1: Upload one or more chest X-rays (PNG/JPG)
home.step3: A Grad-CAM map localizes the regions of interest
home.feature1_desc: COVID-19, lung opacity, viral pneumonia, or normal, with a confidence score per class.
home.feature2_desc: Heatmaps overlaid on the original chest X-ray, to visualize the regions the model deemed relevant.
home.feature3_desc: CSV export of detailed predictions and ZIP export of visualizations, for analysis or archiving.
